presets.name: Terminal
presets.description: The style is a lit dot matrix, and this is the oldest version of that: one phosphor green, one dark ground, no second color anywhere.

presets.name: Amber
presets.description: Same idea, the other phosphor. Amber on a brown-black ground reads warmer in a list than green does.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: White pixels, no hue at all.
presets.description: For interfaces where color already carries meaning. The style loses nothing structural, because the shapes of the eyes and mouth are what identify an avatar.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: A single glow color across a whole set, so the eye and mouth shapes are the only thing that changes from one avatar to the next.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Dusty pixels on a slate ground.
presets.description: The style ships nine bright colors, which is a lot of shouting in a sidebar. These six are lit enough to read on dark and quiet enough to sit still.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: Past what the style ships. On a black ground these read as actual light rather than as paint.

presets.name: Cool
presets.description: Half the color wheel, and the counterpart to Warm. Two groups of avatars can be told apart by temperature alone.

presets.name: Warm
presets.description: The other half of the same wheel, on a ground warmed to match.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. Both stops stay dark, because the lit pixels need something to be lit against.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.description: The face sits in the middle of a wide grid. Scaling up trades some of the grid for size, which is the trade you want at 32 pixels.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The style ships an animation component that is off by default. The `animation` tag switches it on and lets the seed pick a speed. It respects prefers-reduced-motion.
